faq.heading: Most frequently
faq.description: We've compiled answers to the questions our clients ask most often. If your question isn't answered here, contact us directly.

items.question: What types of companies does ProFinance Solutions serve?
items.answer: We serve companies of every size, from small entrepreneurs to large holding groups. Start-ups, local businesses, branches of foreign companies, manufacturing enterprises, trading companies — we have clients from every sector. What matters to us is not the size of the company, but a genuine commitment to financial health.

items.question: Why is the initial consultation free?
items.answer: Because we work on a partnership basis. At the initial meeting, we learn about your company's situation, needs and objectives. This stage allows us to propose the most appropriate solution and gives you the opportunity to assess real value with no obligations whatsoever.

items.question: Do you provide services that are fully compliant with Azerbaijani legislation?
items.answer: Yes. All our services are conducted in full compliance with the Tax Code of the Republic of Azerbaijan, the Labour Code, IFRS standards and other applicable legislation. Changes in legislation are continuously monitored and clients are notified in a timely manner.

items.question: Is it possible to use several services at the same time?
items.answer: Yes, and this is actually the recommended approach. Accounting, tax, HR and financial management are closely interlinked. Combined services deliver more consistent and faster results. Many of our clients use several services simultaneously.

items.question: How is the confidentiality of my data protected?
items.answer: A non-disclosure agreement (NDA) is signed with every client. Your company's data is accessible only to the project team members concerned and is never passed to third parties. All documents are stored in an encrypted environment.

items.question: Is remote service available?
items.answer: Yes. The vast majority of our services can be delivered online in full. Through video meetings, cloud-based document sharing and digital communication channels, we collaborate with clients from any city in Azerbaijan and from abroad.

items.question: When will results become visible?
items.answer: Initial results are typically seen within 2–4 weeks: issues in the accounting system are identified, tax risks are assessed, and processes are documented. Strategic outcomes — budget discipline, tax savings, HR effectiveness — are achieved within 3–6 months.
